senses.gloss:
रुध् रुध्, ii. 7, रुणध्, रुण्ध्, Par. Ātm. (i. 4, see अनु),
 1. To obstruct, MBh. 1, 2367; to check, Rām. 2, 63, 43; to stop, Vikr. d. 121; to obscure, 3, 55, 10.
 2. To keep off, Rām. 1, 28, 22.
 3. To confine, Man. 9, 12; to arrest, Vikr. d. 103.
 4. To bind, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.
 5. To hold, to support Megh. 10.
 6. To besiege, MBh. 3, 638 (anomal. अरुन्धत्).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रुद्ध.
 1. Obstructed, stopped, retained, Chr. 33, 33.
 2. Opposed.
 3. Shut, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 14 (separate, रुद्धा दृष्टिः, ‘His eye is shut’).
 4. Besieged.
 5. Surrounded.
 6. Secured, held, Śiś. 9, 75; taken possession of, Pañc. 227, 21. f. धा, A siege.
 --Caus. To cause to be besieged, Ragh. 12, 71; epic anomal. रुन्धय, To obstruct, pain, MBh. 3, 999.
 --With [] the prep. अनु अनु, To retain, Man. 5, 63.
 --i. 4, Ātm. (originally pass.; in epic poetry also with the terminations of the Par., MBh. 4, 492).
 1. (To comply with), to approve, MBh. 3, 13891.
 2. To obey, Utt. Rāmac. 97, 7.
 3. To spare, MBh. 2, 926.
 4. To love, MBh. 3, 16194; Utt. Rāmac. 66, 8; to caress, ib. 71, 1. अनुरुद्ध,
 1. Checked.
 2. Soothed.
 --With अव अव,
 1. To restrain, Rām. 2, 30, 9; to stop, Śāk. d. 35.
 2. To keep in order, Man. 8, 236.
 3. To besiege, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 23. अवरुद्ध,
 1. Checked.
 2. Shut up, secluded, as in a haram. Frequent. रोरुध्, To offend, Rām. 2, 58, 20.
 --With आ आ, To keep off, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 49.
 --Caus. To obstruct, MBh. 1, 4188.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To obstruct, Man. 8, 348.
 2. To block up, Man. 7, 195.
 3. To molest, Śāk. 24, 8; to trouble, 18, 10.
 4. To obscure, Ragh. 7, 36. उपरुद्ध,
 1. Obstructed.
 2. Covered.
 3. Favoured.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To obstruct, Hit. i. d. 154, M.M.; to stop, Śāk. d. 169.
 2. To restrain, MBh. 3, 13633.
 3. To confine, Man. 11, 176.
 4. To keep off, Bhag. 16, 20. निरुद्ध, Obstructed (not able to work fitly), Pañc. ii. d. 164.
 --Caus. To cause to be shut, Rājat. 5, 428.
 --With संनि सम्-नि, To confine, Man. 9, 83.
 --With प्र प्र, To keep back, MBh. 3, 16830.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To obstruct, MBh. 3, 12114; to stop, Chr. 43, 30.
 2. To make unable to move, Chr. 28, 21.
 3. To interrupt, to make imperfect, Man. 11, 11.
 4. To accuse unjustly, Man. 11, 88. प्रतिरुद्ध,
 1. Impeded.
 2. Surrounded, blockaded.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To withhold, MBh. 2, 227.
 2. To obstruct, Ṛt. 6, 26; to check, Rām. 2, 36, 10.
 3. To combat, [] to quarrel with, Pañc. iii. d. 123; iv. d. 82. विरुद्ध,
 1. Opposed, hindered.
 2. Prohibited, Man. 4, 15.
 3. Contrary, opposite, Śiś. 9, 62; Pañc. 131, 11; perverse, Pañc. 199, 4; ˚धम्, Perversely, Pañc. i. d. 64.
 4. Inconsistent, incongruous, Bhāṣāp. 70; Pañc. 130, 1.
 5. Hostile, Rājat. 5, 452; Pañc. 213, 20; disagreeable, Hit. 58, 18.
 6. Surrounded, blockaded, shut up, Pañc. iv. d. 78.
 --Comp.
 1.
 --Caus. To obstruct, MBh. 3, 360. विरोधित, Fought with, Pañc. iii. d. 1.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To obstruct, MBh. 3, 2541; to check, 2, 226.
 2. To refrain, MBh. 3, 13633.
 3. To fetter, Bhartṛ. 2, 14. संरुद्ध,
 1. Obstructed, Man. 8, 295.
 2. Attacked, 8, 235.
 --Comp.
 अ-, adj. unimpeded, Rājat. 5, 453.
 --Caus. To cause to be embanked, 5, 106.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To keep off, Rām. 2, 14, 42.
ऽरुध् -रुध्, adj. Impeding; e. g. कर-, adj. Impeding the hand, or rays, viz. of the sun, Megh. 40.

रुधिर रुधिर (from a vb. रुध्, lost in corresponding signification), n.
 1. Blood, Pañc. 123, 14.
 2. Saffron.
 --Cf. O.H.G. rôt; A.S. reád, roder; ἐρυθρός, ἐρεύθω, ῥούσιος; Lat. rutilus (for old ruthilus), rufus, ruber, robigo, etc.
